action_taken: Created backend/sql/schema.sql from the MySQL 8.0 DDL, including AUTO_INCREMENT=56800235.
rationale: The table and seed id are the storage contract for Base62 codes of at least five characters.

action_taken: Created backend/go.mod and backend/go.sum for module url-shortener on Go 1.27.4 with the allow-listed direct requirements.
rationale: Gate 3C needs the module before handlers can be built and tested.

action_taken: Created backend/encoding/base62.go with Encode and Decode.
rationale: Deterministic ID-to-Base62 encoding avoids hash-collision retries on insert.

action_taken: Created backend/config/config.go to read the environment table and build the MySQL DSN.
rationale: Secrets stay in the environment. Prod has no password default.

action_taken: Created backend/repo/mysql.go with bound queries, the transactional insert, and schema apply.
rationale: The repository interface lets service tests use an in-memory fake while production uses database/sql.

action_taken: Created backend/service/url_shortener.go for validation, idempotent create, and redirect lookup.
rationale: Active exact long URLs are reused. Expired rows get a new id and code.

action_taken: Created backend/schedule/cleanup.go to delete at most 500 expired rows per hour with a fixed SQL statement.
rationale: Redirects already 404 when a row is expired. Cleanup only bounds table growth.

action_taken: Created backend/apperror and backend/web for the 201 JSON body, 400 and 503 JSON errors, the 302 redirect, and the HTML 404 page.
rationale: Create responses stay JSON. Missing and expired codes stay friendly HTML, never 301.

action_taken: Created backend/main.go to apply dev schema, start cleanup, and listen on BIND_ADDR.
rationale: Stage 3C wires config, the repository, and the chi router into one process.

action_taken: Ran go test ./... -count=1 -covermode=atomic -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile=coverage.out from backend/. go tool cover -func reported total statement coverage 83.3%. 32 tests passed and none were skipped.
rationale: Gate 4 requires a real coverage total of at least 80% and zero skipped mandatory cases.

action_taken: Mounted Swagger UI at /swagger-ui.html and the OpenAPI 3 document at /v3/api-docs and /v3/api-docs.yaml. Added swaggo/swag v1.16.6 and swaggo/http-swagger/v2 v2.0.2. The document lists POST /api/v1/shorten only.
rationale: The signed swagger playbook publishes the existing create API. It does not change status codes, the schema, or the redirect.

action_taken: Re-ran the Gate 4 coverage command from backend/ after the swagger playbook. go tool cover -func reported total statement coverage 81.9%.
rationale: The playbook requires the existing API tests and the 80% coverage bar to stay green.

action_taken: Added LegalPaths and the LegalPath middleware in backend/web/legal_path.go. Illegal URLs return the shared HTML 404. GET /short/{shortCode} is unchanged.
rationale: The allowlist keeps create, redirect, and Swagger reachable, and stops every other URL before a handler can answer.

action_taken: Re-ran the Gate 4 coverage command from backend/ after the legal-path playbook. go tool cover -func reported total statement coverage 82.8%.
rationale: The playbook keeps the greenfield API tests and adds the illegal-path cases without dropping below 80%.

action_taken: Added public-access and HTML-sanitize middleware after LegalPath. HTML in longUrl returns 400 JSON with message longUrl contains disallowed HTML. The module is bluemonday v1.0.27. Routes stay public and return no 401.
rationale: The signed playbook documents public routes and rejects markup in longUrl with the existing error JSON.

action_taken: Re-ran the Gate 4 coverage command from backend/ after the security playbook. go tool cover -func reported total statement coverage 83.5%.
rationale: The playbook keeps the existing API tests and adds the HTML and public-access cases without dropping below 80%.

action_taken: Replaced README.md with the Go 1.27.4 backend run steps, the React client commands, the Gate 4 coverage command, and the public-access limits. frontend/package.json is not in this workspace.
rationale: The signed docs playbook replaces the short stub with the build, test, and HTTP pointers that match the tree.

action_taken: Re-ran the Gate 4 coverage command from backend/. go tool cover -func reported total statement coverage 83.5%. 44 tests passed and none were skipped.
rationale: line_coverage_ratio is copied from that run. Stage 7 fields stay null because Stage 7 is open. No repair loop ran.

action_taken: Ran docker compose up --build once from the workspace root. It exited 1 with: no configuration file provided: not found. No image was produced.
rationale: Stage 6 has no Dockerfile or compose file. The playbook records that result and does not claim an image.

action_taken: Added the React client in frontend/. It calls POST /api/v1/shorten only. npm test passed 10 tests and npm run build succeeded on Node.js 24.
rationale: The signed client request builds the page from the frontend specs. The Go API and its status codes stay unchanged.

action_taken: Replaced the four client photographs with a cool blue set: navy notebook on a blue-gray desk, a slate tray, blue-gray letterpress sorts, and a blue door opening onto the sea. Alt text and filenames are unchanged.
